Bathroom Remodeling in Bel Aire, KS

Bel Aire is north Wichita's small incorporated enclave — a tight residential community surrounded by Wichita with its own city government and a housing stock that skews 1960s through 1990s. These aren't the tract homes that define the outer suburbs; Bel Aire lots are established, landscaping is mature, and the homes have the character of communities that built out over several decades rather than in a single subdivision wave.

The bathrooms reflect that era. 1960s and 1970s Bel Aire homes have the tile and fixture packages of that period — small-format ceramic tile in colors that date the bathroom immediately, original vanities, and plumbing that's been in service for 50+ years. The 1980s and 1990s homes upgraded to fiberglass surrounds and oak vanities that have aged to the point of needing replacement.

Wheatland Construction remodels bathrooms in Bel Aire and north Sedgwick County. We're a Veterans Approved Builder (ID: 00899), Home Advisor Certified since 2019, and family-owned since 2018.

Bel Aire Bathroom Remodeling Specifics

Chisholm Creek corridor homes: Bel Aire properties adjacent to the Chisholm Creek drainage are more likely to have experienced basement or crawl-space moisture events that show up as elevated humidity at interior bathroom walls. If the subfloor under an older Bel Aire bathroom has been exposed to moisture over time, we'll find it during demo — and we deal with it then, not later.

1960s–1970s homes: Tile replacement, new vanity and fixtures, plumbing assessment for supply line condition (galvanized is possible in this vintage). Layout adjustments where feasible.

1980s–1990s homes: Fiberglass to tile conversion, cultured marble to quartz vanity tops, new fixtures and lighting. Standard scope, good returns.

Permits in Bel Aire

City of Bel Aire for homes inside city limits. We handle all permit applications and inspections.

How We Approach Bathroom Remodeling in

Every bathroom remodel in starts with an in-person assessment. We walk the existing bathroom with you, look at what's behind the walls where it matters (around the tub/shower surround, under the vanity, at the subfloor where it meets the tub), and give you an honest read on what the project actually involves before any numbers get discussed.

We price in writing. Every line item - demo, plumbing, tile, vanity, fixtures, exhaust, permit - is documented before work starts. No surprises mid-project.

Our crew handles demo through final walkthrough. We don't hand off your project to a rotating cast of subcontractors who don't know each other's work. The people who pull the permits are the people who do the work and stand behind it.

Wheatland Construction has held Veterans Approved Builder status (ID: 00899) since we opened and has been Home Advisor Certified since 2019. We're licensed and insured in Kansas. If something isn't right at the final walkthrough, we fix it before we consider the project done.

Frequently Asked Questions About Bathroom Remodeling in Bel Aire

How much does bathroom remodeling cost in Bel Aire, KS?

Bel Aire bathroom remodels range from $8,000 for a guest bath refresh to $26,000+ for a full primary bath renovation. Written, line-item estimates on every project.

Do I need permits for bathroom remodeling in Bel Aire?

Yes — City of Bel Aire requires permits for plumbing and electrical work. We handle all permit applications and inspection scheduling.

My 1970s Bel Aire home still has original tile — can I keep any of it?

Original 1970s ceramic tile in good condition can sometimes be preserved or incorporated. More often the grout is past its life and the original setting mortar makes demo cleaner than trying to build over it. We assess at the consultation and give you an honest answer.

What does a walk-in shower conversion look like in a typical Bel Aire bathroom?

We demo the original tub/shower alcove, frame and waterproof the shower enclosure with a membrane system, install large-format porcelain tile on walls and floor, add a built-in niche, and install a frameless glass panel or door. New shower fixtures. The footprint usually fits within the existing alcove dimensions. We measure during the site visit.

How long does a Bel Aire bathroom remodel take?

2–4 weeks for most projects. Older homes with plumbing infrastructure work run toward the longer end.

Does bathroom remodeling add value in Bel Aire?

Yes. Bel Aire's enclave location in north Wichita with its own city government has maintained property values well. Updated bathrooms are a clear value driver in the established-home market.
